archetype: Archetype 6 (Vibrant Play) & Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy - Indian Festive Fusion)

typography.notes: Use Google Fonts 'Outfit' for all headings and 'Nunito' for body. These provide a friendly, modern, and readable look that complements Indian languages.

descriptions.primary: Rani Pink / Rose - used for primary actions, buttons, important highlights.
descriptions.secondary: Marigold / Amber - used for warning, secondary highlights, floating coins/money accents.
descriptions.accent: Vibrant Violet - used for contrasting cards, active states.
descriptions.background: Soft Cream / Off-white - provides a warm, earthy base instead of clinical white.

visual_style.overall: Colorful 3D, Tactile, Playful, and Trustworthy. Rural Indian SHG focus, meaning accessible but premium.

components.buttons: Must have 3D tactile feel. Example classes: 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground font-bold rounded-2xl shadow-[0_6px_0_0_#be123c] active:shadow-none active:translate-y-[6px] transition-all'
components.cards: Neumorphic/Claymorphic with glass vibes. Example classes: 'bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/40 rounded-3xl shadow-xl overflow-hidden'
components.inputs: Soft inner shadow, large rounded corners. Example classes: 'rounded-xl border-2 border-border focus:border-primary focus:ring-4 focus:ring-primary/20 transition-all shadow-inner bg-white'

visual_style.spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards. Use gap-6 or gap-8 between bento grid items.
visual_style.icons: Use 'lucide-react' with colorful backgrounds or thick stroke weights (2.5) to match the bold UI, alongside the provided 3D rendered icons.

layout.dashboard: Bento-style grid. 1-col on mobile, 3-col on tablet, 4-col on desktop. Break symmetry. Use 'h-full' to ensure cards match height.

images.description: 3D cute piggy bank with rupee symbol. Use in Savings Account overview or contribution cards.
3D floating stack of colorful coins and money bag. Use in Loan application/details section.
3D glowing green checkmark shield. Use for successful payments, approvals, and verified statuses.
3D warning sign. Use for Defaulters list, late fee notices, and warnings.

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the defined CSS variables into 'src/index.css' under ':root' to override the default Shadcn colors.
Add 'Outfit' and 'Nunito' fonts via Google Fonts in index.html and apply them in tailwind config.
For buttons, replace default Shadcn button styles with the custom 3D tactile CSS classes provided.
Wrap dashboard sections in Bento-style grid containers using Tailwind grid classes.
Implement the Multi-language (Hindi, English, Tamil) feature using a simple Context provider with a dictionary.
Use colorful blurred blobs (via CSS radial-gradient) in the background of main screens to create a festive Indian vibe without relying on external images.
Place the 3D images prominently on the Dashboard, Loan pages, and success screens.
All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case.
